notes.title: 230830 version 23789
notes.content:
Game controller is reaquired after alt-tab.
Fixed bug special case where game would fail to complete.

notes.title: 230829 version 23769
notes.content:
Boats can be parked on beaches.
No speed-reduction when climbing terrain.
Solved physics issues when working with pickups onboard helicopter.
Protective suit no longer protect from water and is destroyed.
Damage from energy outburst is more severe.
Fixed bug boat not consuming fuel.
Minor tweaks and balancing.

notes.title: 230813 version 23682
notes.content:
There is less speed-reduction when climbing terrain.
Basecamp video-cartridge cosmetic update.

notes.title: 230809 version 23671
notes.content:
Shift key run-factor changed from x2.0 to x2.5.
Climbing terrain reduces speed.
Water is more toxic.
Helicopter is 16% faster.
Boat is 37% faster.
Ambient radiation-damage no longer reaches player with a delay, but at light-speed, to avoid confusion with damage from energy-projectile.
Red-screen from radiation-damage is signaled screen-upper instead of center.
In-air multi-jump no longer allowed (contact with geometry or ground required).
Updated boat physics to stop boat in contact with static geometry.
Updated boat physics reducing jitter when driving.
Updated game controller zero value to reduce drifting when standing still.
When flying above max altitude there is a warning sound.
Penalty for flying helicopter above max altitude is much higher.
When menu is open game world no longer updates.
Helicopter fuel consumption procedure was refined.
Video footage on cartridges was replaced.
Sequence after game is completed was refined.
Various cosmetic and gameplay tweaks.

notes.title: 230526 version 23241
notes.content:
When helicopter climbs above rated threshold, fuel indicator blinks at double speed.
Fuel-consumption penalty, when helicopter climbs above rated threshold, is much lower.
Threshold when player dies of very low health, was tweaked.

notes.title: 230523 version 23234
notes.content:
Player and radiation-suit takes less damage from energy-outburst.
Player death-by-gravity factors was relaxed (player falling into ground or geometry).
Refined helicopter rotate-towards terrain on landing.
Cosmetic update so energy-outburst projectile is fixed at smallest size.

notes.title: 230421 version 23228
notes.content:
When game is completed there is no fuel consumption penalty for flying above threshold.
Fixed bug where fuel would not transfer from cell to helicopter after game is completed.

notes.title: 230420 version 23224
notes.content:
Support for Microsoft Xbox Series X controller.
Support for Nacon PS4 Wired Compact Controller.
Helicopter-terrain physics refined.
Player-terrain physics refined.
Health charging is 11% faster.
Player-death-by-gravity tolerance refined.
Cosmetic update to valley after first canyon.
Fixed bug where player could get incorrectly killed by gravity.
Fixed bug where player could take damage from water when onboard helicopter.
Low health warning red blinking effect is synchronized to even seconds.

notes.title: 230406 version 23158
notes.content:
Removed water remains in valley after first canyon.
When holding mirror at high angle there is less risk of near z cutting through model.
Fixed bug where player could take damage from water, when onboard boat.
Added supporting blocks under bridge.
